author: StephenM
text:
Stephen Miller frames the 2026 midterms as a stark choice between President Trump’s agenda and the Democratic Party, focusing his contrast on border security, law enforcement, taxes, and national security:

“In America today, in the year 2026, there are only two choices. There is President Trump: America First, Make America Great Again, border security, low taxes, public safety, great schools, great homes, great communities, winning the race for the technology of the future, a strong national defense, a strong military, national security, and taking care of our own people. And then you have the Democrats, socialists, and communists who truly want to rip America apart. Every nut, every bolt, every part of this country, strip it bare. This is a party that wants to defund the police and defund law enforcement. Let’s be very clear. This is not hyperbole. Every Democrat except John Fetterman in the House and Senate voted repeatedly to defund ICE and Border Patrol. They voted to open up our borders to every terrorist, every pedophile, every gang member, every monster on the face of the Earth. This is not exaggeration.”
